## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

| Seam | Landed already (≤S6.3b) | S6.4 gap |
|---|---|---|
| The export projection | `hh-bundle` lowering targets + loss-report conventions | `training_export/1` dialect + `project_training_export` pure fold + reward admissibility + reader-subset enforcement |
| Snapshot claims | `SnapshotClaim`/`CompatibilityRecord`/`ForeignRef` record shapes (S5.4 provider-drift half) | the *trainer* import path — `import_snapshot`, `guard_at_bind`, `export_compatibility_tags`, `export_regression_suite` |
| Debt machinery | `AssumptionDebtRecord`, `validate_removal_test` (member-level), `DebtManager::sweep`/`settle`/`retire` (S6.1b) | `post_import_sweep` (kind `post_import` + `lifecycle.debt.removal_test.scheduled` mints), the `model_version_change` seal-time leg (AC-R-2.9.8-12) |
| Consolidation | the R-2.9.5 retirement gate + candidate fold (S6.1a–S6.3a) | `consolidation_candidates` view + `check_retrained_pin_scope` + `consolidation_verdict`/`consolidation_retirement_record` |
| Cycle orchestration | ordinary campaigns + `SearchBudgetRecord` + `matched_total` arithmetic | `CoEvolutionCycleRecord`/`CyclePolicy`/`CycleDriver` — a LabDocs sidecar, no new run kind |
| Org policy | fleet defaults declared (S4.9/S5.6) | `lab/org-policy-v1` exemplar (`matched_cap`) + `fleet_default_debt_records` |
| Surface | `hh-embed/1` ops + tier-c4 gate pattern | 17 `lab.coevolution.*`/`lab.org_policy.*`/`lab.debt.*` ops, `experimental` + `serves_measurement` |
| Fixtures | — | `NullTrainer` conformance fixture; the interface's reflexive `AssumptionDebtRecord` |

## Decisions

ADR-0325 (D1–D8): the export is a pure projection with typed loss
rows; import never pins and the reverse sweep is a records-out
partition; a retrained pin owes the `model_version_change` expiry +
covering selector; the cycle is a sidecar over ordinary campaigns at
`matched_total`; consolidation is a view + a proven retirement;
`lab/org-policy-v1` is `matched_cap` with debt-backed fleet defaults;
the interface carries its own debt record; seventeen ops sit behind
the one `tier-c4`/`serves_measurement` gate.

## In-run fixes worth recording

- **Reward event class correction** — the first fixtures used
  `metric.emitted`; the ledger's landed class is
  `measurement.metric.emitted`. The admissible set carries the real
  spellings (`measurement.metric.emitted`,
  `measurement.oracle.metric.emitted`,
  `measurement.oracle.verdict`, `oracle.verdict`).
- **`validate_removal_test` deepened** — the seal-time leg now checks
  `model_version_change` expiry (ratified `expiry_condition` *or* the
  additive `expiry.condition`) on model-conditioned/evolution-origin
  records, not only selector presence (`hh-hir/src/debt.rs`;
  `MissingSnapshotScope` both ways).
- **Removability stanza added** — `check-removability.sh` grew the
  S6.4 section: `cargo test -p hh-embed --no-default-features
  --test s6_4` (the honest `Unsupported{by: "tier-c4"}` legs) plus a
  schema walk asserting all 17 ops stay declared (CC7). The earlier
  failure this stanza exposed was the no-features build's dead-code
  path; the cfg-gates now cover `ok`/`claim`/`sealed_defs` test
  helpers.
- **Test-API corrections** — `ForeignRef` construction (provenance
  member), `org_policy_v1` signature (`ExemplarPins`/`OrgPolicyPins`
  + pricing ref), `MatchSpec` field spelling, `RemovalTestContext::
  member_level()`, and the Json-object construction pattern (no
  `as_obj_mut` on the wire `Json`).
